comment: Corrected 2026-10-30 evening (Ashish): Muse Spark is not used anywhere in MemoryLoom. The only Meta model is muse-wonder-1.0 in two effort tiers. All enumerable decisions go through Jev (TypeSafe) by default; the decision backend is swappable per class (decision_backends) and a challenger replaces Jev only by beating it on every benchmark leg and on price. Baseten probe 2026-10-30 FAILED: the grant key refuses all non-Spark inference (HTTP 403), so the Baseten DeepSeek triage lane stays closed, its budget untouched, and challenger spot-checks are deferred; triage runs on Meta Wonder medium. Meta prices are the published standard rates (cheat sheet); Jev is $0.042 per 1M input tokens, output free; Baseten prices are the published Model API rates recorded in docs/baseten-probe-and-challengers.md.
